page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m2.xlarge is a GPU-equipped compute instance built on KVM virtualization within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. The system features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.4 GHz. Paired with this compute core is 16.0 GB of system memory, providing an even 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by an integrated NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPU containing 2 GB of dedicated video memory. The instance features no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage volumes for all disk persistence and operating system installations. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a modest 2 GB VRAM configuration, this server is tuned for lightweight graphical rendering, video stream encoding, or light AI inference rather than heavy distributed model training. The pairing of modern AMD EPYC processing cores with an entry-level modern GPU enables cost-efficient compute workflows where dedicated graphics acceleration is required without the overhead of enterprise-scale accelerator hardware.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m2.xlarge is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual server featuring 4 dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 vCPUs clocked at 3.4 GHz, 16.0 GB of system memory, and a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU with 2 GB of VRAM. Operating under KVM virtualization, it provides a balanced 4:1 memory-to-core ratio alongside entry-level graphics acceleration. The instance does not include local disk storage, depending on remote block storage volumes for persistent data, and features a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This profile suits light graphical rendering, media transcoding, and lightweight model inference.
